newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Galileo CMP gain.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Galileo CMP gain.

text.p: Global computer reservation company Galileo International Inc's $784 million initial public offering locked in an opening premium of 2-1/2 over its IPO price of $24.50, before settling to 26-5/16 in midday trading.
Volume of over 12 million shares made the stock the busiest on the New York Stock Exchange.
Signalling strong demand, the underwriters raised the price talk for the deal late on Thursday to $23 to $25 a share from the $20 to $23 indicated in the filing.

Of a total offering of 31.998 million shares, 12 million were sold by the company and the rest by selling shareholders, according to the filing. Some 22,398,600 shares were sold in the United States and Canada.

According to Securities Data, Galileo comes in behind two of the largest IPOs this year - Santa Fe International Corp with $997.5 million in worldwide proceeds and Boston Properties Inc with $785 million.

Galileo, which is owned by 11 North American and European airlines, counts among its shareholders United Airlines, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV US Airways and British Airways Plc. The company provides electronic global distribution services for the travel industry utilizing a computer reservation system.
Morgan Stanley Dean Witter was lead underwriter on the IPO.

Technology trade publisher CMP Media Inc's shares racked up gains of over 17 percent after pricing at $22 a share, at the high end of a price range that had been raised to $20 to $22 from $17 to $19 per share. Five million shares were on offer in a deal led by Goldman Sachs.

Another Goldman Sachs deal was scheduled to make its debut on Friday, but had not become effective as of 1245 EST. Guangzhou, China-based airline China Southern Airlines Co Ltd's 20.6 million American Depositary Shares, each representing 50 ordinary H (Hong Kong) shares, were expected to price between U.S.$24.20 and U.S.$30.65 per ADS. The Goldman Sachs press office was not able to say whether the deal had been priced or not.
